items.Sentence: Currently onsite are one 7.2 mgd conventional tertiary sand filter (DynaSand), two 5.5 mgd conventional tertiary cloth filters (AquaDisk), 10 percolation ponds which vary in size, five banks of UV disinfection, 18 containment wells and 13 relief wells.
